answer: In a Proof of Agent system, identity verification binds each claimant to a Wesolowski VDF requiring a prescribed sequence of sequential modular squarings, with each output needed to compute the next. An attacker may create a hollow relic or pearl representing a cloned identity, but cannot split that dependency chain across GPUs to reduce its latency; every simulated clone must incur the physical elapsed time, imposing a strict Sybil-resistance bottleneck.
